note: The 15.999 oz step is written '15.999000000000001' in every CSV zip (float artifact). The parser converts ounces to pounds, truncates to 4 decimals and labels the step 0.9999 (common.weight_label).
Ground Advantage retail 2025, 15.999 oz step: zone 9 is $9.35 while zone 8 is $9.45. The Notice 123 PDF (p.7) prints the same values, so this is what the document says; kept as parsed.
Ground Advantage retail 2025, 1 lb step: zone 9 is $9.35 while zone 8 is $9.45 (same values as the 15.999 oz row). The Notice 123 PDF (p.7) prints the same values; kept as parsed.

Ounce steps 4, 8, 12 oz are stored in pounds as 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 (the CSV header says 'Weight Not Over (ounces)' until the 'Weight Not Over (pounds)' marker row, which the parser uses to switch units).
The 15.999 oz row and the 1 lb row carry identical prices in all years and both cards; both are kept as steps.

Flat-rate rows (Flat Rate Envelopes, Small/Medium/Large Flat Rate Boxes) in the PM and PME CSV preambles are not weight steps and are skipped; the 'Oversized' row of the Ground Advantage tables (combined length and girth over 108 in up to 130 in, priced regardless of weight) is skipped too.

Zone 9 is not a distance band: DMM 608.9.4.2 defines it as the Freely Associated States (Palau, Micronesia, Marshall Islands). Parsed because it falls out of the same table; Ground Advantage zone 9 prices equal zone 8, PM/PME zone 9 prices are much higher. Excluded from the dashboard distance mapping (zone_from_distance.csv has no zone 9 row).
Priority Mail commercial has a 0.5 lb step (same price as 1 lb in 2024) that the retail table does not have; it is kept as a step and the retail table starts at 1 lb.
Priority Mail Express has a 0.5 lb step on both cards in all years (SCHEMA lists PM/PME as 1-70 lb only).

Year label 2023 uses the 2023-07-09 tables (Ground Advantage launch). The 2023-07-09 CSV zip is marked 'Proposed' (5/26/2023) in its title rows; its PM/PME prices are identical to the 2023-01-22 zip and the golden cells were checked against the final Notice 123 of 2023-07-09.

2026 adds a 'Nonstandard Characteristic fee' of $4.50 (tubes or rolls, cans, wooden or metal boxes, liquids in glass); recorded as additional_handling_packaging, triggered by the parcel's nonstandard_packaging flag. The 8 % transportation-related time-limited increase (2026-04-26 to 2027-01-17) is recorded as a percent surcharge.
